teaser: "Just pick one," someone says, and you already have three other ideas forming before they finish the sentence. You are a 1, the path of the one who leads, and an ENFP, the type built for sudden light and far reach. The 1 asks for a single aim held long enough to become a result; the ENFP mind generates aims the way a sparkler throws off light, fast and bright and gone. What is particular here is not a lack of conviction — there is plenty of that — it is being certain of six different directions in one afternoon. Decided and restless are the two words that live together naturally in this reading.
